title: APP ordinal ranking tie-aware sensitivity and deterministic tie-break audit
hypothesis: The small favorable historical Blind OOS mean-rank estimate in Q123 may be sensitive to exact-score ties resolved deterministically by smaller-number tie-break. A tie-neutral midrank analysis will show whether ordinal rank skill remains after removing arbitrary within-tie ordering; the paired deterministic-minus-midrank difference quantifies tie-break contribution.

definitions.exact_tie: Two APP scores are tied iff their IEEE-754 numeric values are exactly equal; no rounding or tolerance is applied.
definitions.deterministic_rank: Exact APP order: score descending, then smaller number first.
definitions.midrank: For a tied group occupying one-based rank slots r..r+m-1, every member receives r+(m-1)/2.
definitions.fractional_top_k: For a tied group intersecting the first K rank slots in c slots, each member receives c/m credit; a target draw's fractional hits are the sum of its five members' credits.
definitions.tie_break_gain: Mean(midrank - deterministic rank) for drawn numbers; positive values mean the smaller-number deterministic tie-break makes observed ranks look better than tie-neutral midranks.

method.scorer: Exact committed APP scorer extracted from overlapCount, sonarTransitionProfile and sonarAnalogCore in pinned src/VinciCasaLab.jsx; no source edits.
method.split_rule: Chronological 60/20/remainder using rounded first two split sizes.
method.strict_prior: For target index t, scorer receives only archive rows [0,t); target and all later rows are excluded.

inference.p_value: One-sided upper tail for the preregistered gain; plus-one correction.
inference.multiplicity: Holm across the five endpoints above; no claim that this corrects the full Q00–Q124 research family.

leakage_controls: Pin canonical archive, exact APP scorer source, APP data and active-engine report blob SHAs.
Reconcile APP modelDraws row-by-row with canonical archive.
For every target, execute scorer on the strict prior prefix only; score actual draw after ranking is frozen.
Verify all 40 numbers appear exactly once and all scores are finite.
Verify exact tie groups partition all 40 scores and midrank sum is exactly 820.
Verify fractional TopK credits sum to K for K=5,10,20.
Mutate target and future suffix at nine fixed target indices and verify current ranking/tie partition is unchanged.
Replay report, ledger, validation, freeze and checkpoint deterministically; verify Git blob SHA and byte sizes from repository readback.
guardrails: Research-only sensitivity audit; no scorer, production ranking, Q60 record or prior freeze is modified.
The 2026-11-11 freeze is separate from Q60 and remains pending until official contest 315 publication.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR exploration.
No automatic merge, engine promotion or modification of PR #6, #7 or #8.
decision_rule: Do not infer ordinal skill from deterministic ranks if tie-neutral midrank gain fails Holm-adjusted p<0.05. If deterministic tie-break advantage is positive, report it as a ranking-policy sensitivity, not predictive skill. No production promotion.
next_action: After official publication of contest 315, evaluate the pre-existing Q123/Q124 freezes without retuning and continue append-only Q60 paired collection.
